text:
deploybot: starting v2 canary -> 10% at 09:12 UTC. initial probes green, but early user telemetry shows a jump in 429 + client retry storms from mobile SDKs.

hana: looks like clients are getting back responses missing top-level request headers they introspect. stack shows SDK code expecting `resp.meta.headers[\"x-req-meta\"]` then spamming retries when nil.

jules: can you paste an example failing response payload?

qa-bot: sample payloads (sanitized) from last 15m:
```json
{
  "version": 2,
  "result": { "text": "ok" },
  "meta": null,
  "meta.headers": { "x-req-meta": null },
  "x-request-id": "r-999"
}
```

hana: the v2 serializer moved request-level diagnostic headers under `meta.headers` but on some branches the serializer collapses empty headers to `null`. older SDKs probe `meta` at top level and then inspect `meta.headers`. when `meta` is null they crash/retry.

mike: which runtime variant / shard emitted the bad payloads?

ops: affected shards: region=us-east shard=aurora-07, runtime=v2-serialize-1.3. recent perf micro-optim landed in PR #4250 that touched header canonicalization.

release-manager: impact scope? how many tenants and which customer types?

qa-bot: ~150 tenants in the sample set. 70% are mobile SDKs <2.5.0. Dedicated customers mostly unaffected. Rough spike window: 09:14-09:28 UTC.

hana: suggested immediate mitigation:
- pause canary progression
- pin aurora-07 to v1-rt (or cordon)
- deploy an edge/gateway header normalizer that ensures `meta` is an object and copies legacy header paths for older SDK user-agents
- revert the serializer change in v2-serialize-1.3 if rollout cannot continue

ops: agree. we'll cordon aurora-07 and shift its traffic to other v2 shards + v1 fallback if needed. watch token/sec.

jules: i can open a quick PR to add defensive serialization: ensure `meta` defaults to `{}` and `meta.headers` defaults to `{}` in the runtime. PR #4251 (draft). ETA ~60m for tests.

se-liaison: SEs should get a short list of impacted tenant IDs so they can reach out. also a suggested customer message: "If your app uses Redwood SDK <2.5.0, please upgrade to avoid retry storms when we advance v2. We temporarily held advancement while we fix a serializer edge-case."

release-manager: i'll update release notes and post a short status update to status.redwood. include rollback criteria and contact.

mike: rollback criteria proposal:
- if client retry rate (unique clients with >3 retries/min) > 0.4% for 30m after pause -> full rollback to v1 across routes
- if 500s or 429s from gateway normalizer exceed baseline +0.5% for 30m -> rollback

qa-bot: running an automated integration matrix: SDK <2.5.0, SDK >=2.5.0, web, dedicated. will validate gateway shim and runtime PR against all.

ops: canary progression paused by operator. aurora-07 cordon starting now.

deploybot: canary advance paused at 10% by operator.

jules: PR opened (draft): https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4251 - adds null-guards and header defaults. kicking CI.

hana: are we comfortable with a gateway shim until runtime patch lands? it buys time and avoids forcing full rollback.

ops: gateway shim is low-risk; will scope to clients with `User-Agent` < "redwood-sdk/2.5.0". expecting small CPU delta. will monitor for 5xxs.

se-liaison: please add tenant samples to the outreach: t-204, t-512, t-8809. SEs will ringfence support for those.

release-manager: action list:
- pause canary (done)
- cordon aurora-07 (in progress)
- deploy gateway header normalizer (ops)
- merge runtime PR #4251 and roll to aurora-07 (jules)
- update release notes & customer comms (release-manager)
- SE outreach for impacted tenants (se-liaison)

mike: timeline: aim to have gateway shim live in 20m, runtime patch merged and to aurora-07 in 90m, then hold 2h observation window before considering re-advance.

ops: cordon done. shifting traffic. watching capacity.

deploybot: operator note: canary progression halted. will not resume without explicit +ops. tagging @ops for signoff.

jules: CI flaky on one integration test, investigating. will ping when green.

qa-bot: running targeted regression tests now. will post matrix results to the thread.

release-manager: prepping status page and release note copy. include migration snippet and clear SDK version callout.

hana: decision: hold advancement, use gateway shim as bridge, deploy runtime null-guard patch, observe 2h after patch. if any of rollback criteria breach, full rollback to v1.

mike: thanks all. keep updates short here; SEs and customers waiting.
